notes: Nine consecutive localized object-state episodes are visible. The initial and intervening camera surveys were excluded. Paired doors belonging to a single accessed cabinet compartment were treated as one compartment-opening episode because they were manipulated together without disengagement; spatially separate cabinet compartments were retained as separate events.
scene_description: A user moves through a residential kitchen and sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry, two separate upper-cabinet compartments, two countertop cooker lids, and an air-fryer basket.
